At a press conference, Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) co-convener Saurav Das takes a swipe at the Modi government, saying that if he were Nirav Modi, Vijay Mallya or Mehul Choksi, he would have received VIP treatment and reached London within hours. He also speaks about a show-cause notice over discrepancies in his place of birth and alleges that the government stopped him from travelling abroad.
